title: OpenHands Agent Canvas on Nebius
tagline: Run the OpenHands Agent Canvas on a Nebius VM, with Token Factory serving Qwen3-32B as the LLM.

story.problem: You want a self-hosted, always-on coding agent you can drive from the browser, without wiring up your own UI, agent runtime, and LLM plumbing.
story.solution: Run OpenHands Agent Canvas on a Nebius Compute VM in public mode, and point its OpenHands agent at Qwen3-32B served by Nebius Token Factory.
story.outcome: A browser-accessible agent control center running entirely on Nebius infrastructure, ready for conversations and automations in about fifteen minutes.

prerequisites: A Nebius Cloud account with permission to create Compute VMs
An SSH key pair for reaching the VM

quickstart.clone: ssh <user>@<vm-ip>  # a Nebius Compute VM with Node.js 22+ and uv

endpoints.description: Agent Canvas web UI, served by the built-in ingress on port 8000.
